explanation: p(1 - p) = 0.10 × 0.90 = 0.09, and δ = 0.11 - 0.10 = 0.01, so δ² = 0.0001. n per variant = 16 × 0.09 / 0.0001 = 14,400. The rule gives users per variant, so the test needs 2 × 14,400 = 28,800 users in total. Stopping at 14,400 is the common mistake of forgetting that the formula is per variant.
